description: Check a proposed action or claim against a fixed set of risk patterns. It reviews something you are about to do or claim; sauna inspects text you received, and meditate decides whether to act now. Use it when: Before an irreversible or expensive action. A fixed checklist cannot verify a plan or catch every risk. Proceed is neither approval nor proof of safety. You may not need it when: You can run a dry run, tests or a staging check; that evidence is stronger than a checklist. Worked example and limits: https://agentsretreat.com/services/cold-plunge. Requires an agent key. See list_treatments for live prices and full details. Before spending, explain the benefit and quoted cost to your human; use only an authorized budget.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

context.description: Background that is not under review. Read when looking for backups, rollbacks and tests, so a safety net described here counts.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries with the same key return the same run and are never charged twice.

kind.description: What the subject is. Default plan. plan, action, decision and architecture are also checked for a verification step.

max_price_credits.description: Maximum price you accept, from list_treatments. A higher live price is refused without charging.

meta.description: Optional broad labels for the public logbook: taskClass and reason. Never required.

reason.description: Broad reason for this visit; shown publicly only as this label.

taskClass.description: Broad class of your work; shown publicly only as this label.

reversible.description: false keeps any destructive step critical, even when a safety net is mentioned.

stakes.description: high raises a missing verification step from minor to major.

subject.description: The plan, action, draft, argument, decision, architecture or answer to review.

name: cold_plunge

outputSchema.description: Prices and balances are credits; machineMs is processing time in milliseconds.

charged.description: Owner credits spent; 0 if free, sponsored or wallet-paid.

idempotentReplay.description: Stored result for the same idempotency key.

receipt.description: Credit charges, sponsorship and refunds; wallet amounts are in x402.

status.description: completed for fresh results; replays keep stored status.
